value.content: {"id": "portswigger_cmd_injection", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "os_command_injection", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: OS Command Injection", "name": "OS Command Injection & Safe Time-Delay Verification Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-78", "owasp_category": "A03:2021 - Injection", "signals": ["ip_ping_parameter", "system_tool_wrapper", "file_conversion_endpoint", "shell_metacharacter_echo", "time_delay_execution"], "verification_strategy": "Inject benign shell command delimiters (;, |, &, `) paired with safe time-delay instructions (e.g., sleep 5, ping -c 5 127.0.0.1) across suspected parameters. Compare response execution duration against baseline latency.", "evidence_requirements": ["differential_time_delay_metric", "baseline_vs_probe_duration", "shell_execution_proof"], "tools": [{"tool": "CmdInjectionSkill", "cmd": "CmdInjectionSkill.run(url, param)", "desc": "Differential latency auditor using non-destructive time delays and benign echoes"}, {"tool": "commix (safe mode)", "cmd": "commix -u 'https://example.com/status?host=127.0.0.1' --batch --time-sec=5", "desc": "Automated command injection auditor validating execution pathways"}], "remediation": "Avoid invoking operating system shell commands via system(), exec(), or Runtime.getRuntime().exec(). Utilize native language APIs (e.g., standard file and network libraries) or apply strict alphanumeric parameter allowlists.", "description": "PortSwigger OS Command Injection covers simple injections returning command output, blind command injection with time delays, out-of-band data redirection, and output redirection to web-accessible directories."}
